_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The August 2024 analog is the highest-matching pattern at 76.6% and both brains see the same ETF-flow + DXY-weakness setup, but with 0 of 34 recent 12h windows producing a ±2-point move and the analyst's own direction accuracy at 17.1%, the statistically honest call is HOLD until the breaker confirms — not a guess at which way the coil resolves.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst calls direction UP with low conviction while explicitly doubting its own call; narrative implies UP resolution with higher conviction but does not address the base-rate coil reality.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with price pushing $67K+ and Fear & Greed climbing past 35, or ETH ETF flows spike above 85 with SOL following — validating alt rotation and Hope-phase momentum.
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY breaking 100.5 and BTC funding flipping negative, or exchange reserves reverse with netflow turning strongly positive (>60), indicating distribution not accumulation.
